snippet.title: [Lyric video] Analog (acapella)
snippet.description:
The lyric video is out today. :)
Take your time with the lyrics and hope the music brings you a moment of calm.
The official music video will be coming your way very soon! Thank you.🙏

Here are the links to our new track — we’d really appreciate it if you give it a listen!!
🍈 Melon  https://www.melon.com/album/detail.htm?albumId=13360308

🛒 Amazon Music  https://music.amazon.ca/albums/B0GYG9RLT6

🌍 More platforms  
https://lnk.dmsmusic.co/maytree_analog

'아날로그' 음원이 발매되었습니다! 가사가 더 와닿았으면 해서, Lyric video를 먼저 공개합니다. :)
오피셜 뮤직비디오도 곧 오픈될 예정입니다. 
위의 음원 링크도 많은 관심 부탁드려요!! 감사합니다🙏
